integrity: All integer counts are obtained by an explicitly proved recurrence and complete deterministic enumeration, with independently recomputed literal index decks at short lengths and for every collision pair.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification only for binary gap-three multiplicity decks at lengths 7 through 17; no claim for shorter vacuous or longer lengths. Potential equivalent results not indexed in examined primary literature cannot be ruled out.
title: First informative collision and complete ambiguity census for binary three-separated three-decks
